entries.what: Slept 8:30 to 3 after a Sunday-night stretch, then reloaded the laundry card and did a load in the Marisol Gardens laundry room before packing leftover rice for work.
entries.outcome: Clean scrubs ready for the week.
entries.feeling: groggy but on top of it

entries.what: Made two thermoses of cà phê sữa đá, took the nurse shuttle up Ortega Hill from the gravel lot and worked a quiet-ish night on 4 West with Jasmine.
Came off shift, then went to the paid 8-hour charting training at St. Anselm, sitting through the new system walkthrough with Rubén, who already knew the shortcuts.
entries.outcome: Finished training with a login and a pile of printed notes.

entries.what: Stopped at Ruiz Family Market Tuesday afternoon for fish sauce and produce, then crashed late with the box fan on.
entries.outcome: Groceries done; slept only a few hours.

entries.what: Woke up and reorganized the already-labeled pantry bins by expiration date, moving the soonest-to-expire to the front.
entries.outcome: Pantry sorted; nothing was actually out of order.

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop before her shift, then worked 4 West overnight with the new charting still on her mind.
entries.outcome: Got through the night with Maribel's usual vitals-on-glove routine.

entries.what: Heard through the wall that Elliot's household was having a rough evening with Theo's crying; put in earplugs and turned on the white noise.
Slept through most of the day; let a Vietnamese voicemail from Hạnh go unheard on the phone.
Spent the evening off, reheating dinner and watching her baking show on the couch.
entries.outcome: Early night to reset her sleep.

entries.what: Texted Linh to check in about her anatomy class and her week at the cafe.
entries.outcome: Linh said she was fine, which Thao doubted.

entries.what: Spent a day off watering the pothos and the struggling basil on the balcony and tidying the apartment.
Walked the marsh boardwalk in the late afternoon, then packed two thermoses and a rice lunch for work.
Worked a night on 4 West, with Dr. Mehta paging twice and apologizing both times.
Finished shift and went to Phở Bến Thành with Jasmine for phở tái after the night.
entries.outcome: Good breakfast, a bit of venting about the upcoming go-live.

entries.what: Heard from Rochelle's circle that the Ridgeline hiring fair was packed; Linh mentioned friends lining up early, and Thao slept through most of the town noise.
Made a quick dinner of eggs and rice and answered texts before sleeping again.
Woke up and got ready for Sunday dinner at Hạnh's Pell Road house, bringing a dish.
Had dinner with Hạnh and Linh, who deflected questions about pharmacy while Thao steered the conversation elsewhere.
Drove home in the hatchback, noticing the slow passenger tire again, and turned in early.
entries.outcome: Made a mental note to get the tire checked.
